entries.english:
Here, monsters battle each other. You choose one and bet your tokens on it.
Look at the entrants and the odds, then choose the monster you think will survive!
If that monster survives the match, your tokens will multiply according to its odds!
The odds change with every match. A monster that paid out 1.2 times your bet before might pay out 3 times as much now!
You can bet between 10 and 100 tokens.
However big you win, we can only pay out up to 99,999 tokens at once. Keep that in mind!
That's all there is to it!

entries.english:
Here, your allied monsters battle a team of our hand-picked monsters!
To take part, just bring along some monster allies.
Their combined levels must be no more than eight times the number of monsters on our team. If they're over that limit, we can't let them enter.
Our monsters always move first.
The battle continues until every monster on one side is defeated.
After 30 turns, time is up and our team wins!
If your monsters win, we'll hand over a big prize. That's about it!

entries.english:
Here, you can register monsters raised in another Adventure Log and battle them!
If a friend plays this game and has monster allies, ask them to enter an ally's password here. We'll register it for you!
Once it's registered, you can battle your friend's monster whenever you like!
You can check a monster's password with the command at our Monster lodge.
Defeat all the opposing monsters first to win. There aren't any prizes, so just enjoy the battle!
Before you fight, you can choose which side moves first. That's about it!
